# The world-development feed

World Bank, World Development Indicators.

The economy module's public-sector world-development pack (docs/guides/PUBLIC_SECTOR_GUIDE.md): World Bank World Development Indicators by country and year: population, GDP per head and growth, inflation, unemployment, life expectancy, poverty, access to electricity, internet use and central government debt for every economy, from the World Bank's API (CC BY 4.0). A country's profile shows the latest of each indicator and the world map shaded by GDP per head; each series shows its history by year. Filled daily by the world-development feed into the worldlake lake. The one fetcher of WDI: as series it also pulls every WDI code of the world-economy pack (tools/realdata/sources.yaml) and the World Bank's aggregates, which the world-economy feed reads from its output.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | World Bank, World Development Indicators (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/) |
| Licence | [CC BY 4.0](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/legal/terms-of-use-for-datasets): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0). |
| Lake | `worldlake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 06:30 (local time) |
| Pull | `world_development.WorldDevelopmentFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/world_development.py); 0.5 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run world-development --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run world-development                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/world-development/<date>/, load into worldlake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status world-development             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [EXTERNAL_DATA.md](../../docs/guides/EXTERNAL_DATA.md).

## Data contract

### development-profile

Pack `world-development`, kind `development-profile` (Development profile), table `development-profile`, key `PROFILE_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/world-development/<date>/development-profile.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PROFILE_ID` | id | required | WDI- and the country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. |
| `ISO3` | text | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, the key the map shades by. |
| `ISO2` | text | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (the World Bank's own id). |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. |
| `REGION` | id | required | The World Bank region the economy belongs to (East Asia & Pacific, Sub-Saharan Africa ...). |
| `INCOME_GROUP` | id | required | The World Bank income group by GNI per head (Low, Lower middle, Upper middle, High income). |
| `CAPITAL` | text | optional | The capital city as the World Bank lists it. |
| `POPULATION` | amount | optional | Total population, mid-year (SP.POP.TOTL), the latest year with a value. |
| `GDP_PER_CAPITA` | amount | optional | GDP divided by mid-year population, current US dollars (NY.GDP.PCAP.CD), the latest year. |
| `GDP_GROWTH` | rate | optional | Annual growth of GDP at constant prices (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG), the latest year. |
| `INFLATION` | rate | optional | Consumer price inflation (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG), the latest year. |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | amount | optional | Unemployed share of the labour force, ILO modelled estimate (SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS), the latest year. |
| `LIFE_EXPECTANCY` | amount | optional | Life expectancy at birth (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), the latest year. |
| `POVERTY_HEADCOUNT` | amount | optional | Share living below the World Bank's international poverty line (SI.POV.DDAY), the latest survey year. |
| `ELECTRICITY_ACCESS` | amount | optional | Share of the population with access to electricity (EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS), the latest year. |
| `INTERNET_USERS` | amount | optional | Share of the population using the internet (IT.NET.USER.ZS), the latest year. |
| `CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT_DEBT` | amount | optional | Central government debt, total (GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS), the latest year; empty for most economies that do not report it. |
| `INDICATORS` | record list | required | Every indicator the feed pulled for the economy, one row each: INDICATOR, UNIT, LATEST, YEAR, CODE and WDI_SERIES. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |
| `DATA_YEAR` | text | optional | The most recent year any indicator of the economy has a value for. |
| `INDICATOR_COUNT` | integer | required | How many indicators have at least one value for the economy. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"PROFILE_ID": "WDI-AUS", "NAME": "Australia", "ISO3": "AUS", "ISO2": "AU", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Australia", "REGION": "East Asia & Pacific", "INCOME_GROUP": "High income", "CAPITAL": "Canberra", "POPULATION": 27614411.0, "GDP_PER_CAPITA": 65129.7227990563, "GDP_GROWTH": 1.35039785076631, "INFLATION": 2.87403791660173, "UNEMPLOYMENT": 4.09, "LIFE_EXPECTANCY": 83.0512195121951, "POVERTY_HEADCOUNT": 0.9, "ELECTRICITY_ACCESS": 100.0, "INTERNET_USERS": 96.13140106, "CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT_DEBT": 57.8834285733848, "DATA_YEAR": "2025", "INDICATOR_COUNT": 10}
```

The contract: `config/packs/world-development/contracts/development-profile.contract.yaml` ([world-development](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-development.md)).

### development-series

Pack `world-development`, kind `development-series` (Development indicator series), table `development-series`, key `SERIES_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/world-development/<date>/development-series.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required | WDIS-, the country's ISO alpha-3 code and the indicator's code with its dots as underscores. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The country and the indicator, as one name. |
| `WDI_PROFILE` | id | optional | The country's development-profile page (WDI-<ISO3>); empty for a World Bank aggregate (the world, a region, an income group), which has series but no profile. |
| `ISO3` | text | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, or the World Bank aggregate's code (WLD the world, EAS ... SSF the regions, HIC ... LIC the income groups). |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. |
| `INDICATOR_CODE` | text | required | The indicator's code in the World Bank API. |
| `INDICATOR` | text | required | The indicator's name as the World Bank publishes it. |
| `UNIT` | text | required | What the value measures (the feed's YAML names it). |
| `DEFINITION` | text | optional | The World Bank's source note for the indicator, cut at 600 characters. |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The latest published value, in the unit shown. |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | text | required | The calendar year of the latest value. |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | The value of the year before the latest one with a value; empty for a one-year series. |
| `PREVIOUS_YEAR` | text | optional | The year of the previous value. |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | The latest value less the previous one, in the unit shown. |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The value by year, oldest first, over the feed's window (YEAR, VALUE). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"SERIES_ID": "WDIS-CAN-EG_ELC_ACCS_ZS", "NAME": "Canada · Access to electricity (% of population)", "WDI_PROFILE": "WDI-CAN", "ISO3": "CAN", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Canada", "INDICATOR_CODE": "EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS", "INDICATOR": "Access to electricity (% of population)", "UNIT": "% of population", "DEFINITION": "Access to electricity is the percentage of population with …", "LATEST": 100.0, "LATEST_YEAR": "2024", "PREVIOUS": 100.0, "PREVIOUS_YEAR": "2023", "CHANGE": 0.0}
```

The contract: `config/packs/world-development/contracts/development-series.contract.yaml` ([world-development](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-development.md)).
